parsed.explanation: The state stands under the parent's operative visitor-facing regime: visa adjudication directing refusal where documents cast doubt on sex, advisories issued by eight governments, federal single-sex facility exclusion, and detention exposure (conversion-therapy-style policies, documented abuse in immigration custody). Those national rules apply regardless of local law. State-specific additions move both ways. Up: courts repeatedly enjoin anti-trans statutes under the state constitution — facilities bill restrained on animus grounds, care ban permanently struck, marker-change blocks affirmed on dignity grounds; it is the only unit whose 2026 standing improved, and no in-force state facility ban or documented state violence appears. Down: an in-force religious-exemption discrimination law, hostile display/speech rules, a state hate-crime statute lacking gender identity, and an unresolved 2026 anatomical-gender statute. Net above the parent average, but universal national exposures hold it out of Reduced Risk.
